newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-AMP says no comment on ScotAm report in FT.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-AMP says no comment on ScotAm report in FT.

text.p: The Australian Mutual Provident Society (AMP) said on Tuesday that it had no comment on a report in London's Financial Times newspaper that the 2.0 billion stg bidding war for insurance group Scottish Amicable had been won by Prudential Corp Plc.
Prudential and AMP, Australia's largest insurer and funds manager with more than A$90 billion of assets under management, were competing with Abbey National Plc.
AMP group communications manager Bob Pritchard said the Scottish Amicable board was due to meet at midnight Tuesday Sydney time (1300 GMT) and would decide the winner.
"It is our understaning they are going to make a decision," Pritchard said, adding he did not know if the board would publicly reveal its decision soon after.
